name: South Carolina Masters Swimming — South Carolina Records
description: The fastest swim by a South Carolina US Masters Swimming member in each event, course, gender, and age group for every season since 2000, across every South Carolina club.

datasets.name: South Carolina Records
datasets.description: Each season's South Carolina #1 time per course, event, gender, and age group.

schema.team: USMS club code of the swimmer, e.g. 'COLM'
schema.course: Pool course: scy (Short Course Yards), scm (Short Course Meters), or lcm (Long Course Meters)
schema.timeInSeconds: Numeric time in seconds for sorting/comparison
schema.date: Date of the swim (ISO string or null)
schema.meet: Name of the meet where the time was recorded

api.description: Query the records instead of downloading the whole file. Rows are each season's top time per event/course/gender/age group; best=true returns only all-time bests. Responds with {team, query, total, count, records}.

parameters.event: Distance and/or stroke, e.g. '50 free', '200 IM', 'backstroke'
parameters.best: true for only the fastest matching swim per event/course/gender/age group

contentApi.description: Club information read live from the club's Google Sheet: practice schedule, upcoming events, board, FAQ, coaches and any notice. Optional section=club|alert|about|schedule|events|board|faq|coaches; format=md for markdown.

source: US Masters Swimming (usms.org) top times database
